description: This file provides utility functions to check various verification statuses of a Matrix device, including local verification, owner verification, and verification within the current client context.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified( isMatrixDeviceLocallyVerified
methods.description: Checks if a Matrix device is locally verified based on its status object.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified( isMatrixDeviceOwnerVerified
methods.description: Determines if a Matrix device is verified by its owner or via cross-signing.

methods.name: export function isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient( isMatrixDeviceVerifiedInCurrentClient
methods.description: Checks if a Matrix device is verified in the current client, considering local, owner, and other verification statuses.
